ShortDescription.Value: Collect selected mod launcher buttons in a compact dock with one or two rows.

Publish.LongDescription:
Mod Button Manager groups supported mod launcher buttons behind one movable button.
- Open below, to the right or to the left. - Choose one or two rows. - Select which detected buttons belong in the dock. - Choose one shared launcher or separate launchers for left and right. - Keep button bars open until explicitly collapsed. - Save independent launcher positions and open states. - Enable Hide buttons in options to edit the selection with right-click. - Excluded originals return to the normal UI; selection previews have 40% opacity. - Disable the selection option to remove previews from the manager. - Light-blue launcher style matching existing mod buttons. - Keep original mod button components and click handlers. - English and German interface.
